title: research.run result envelope
description: wait=false returns only {run_id, status: "running"}; wait=true returns the full envelope.

status.description: wait=false returns "running" (job handle); wait=true returns "complete" or "partial". A failed run never produces this envelope — it surfaces as an MCP tool error and a failed checkpoint readable via research.get_status. "interrupted" is a checkpoint status: the owning process exited without a terminal write while its run lock was free (a graceful shutdown writes "partial" with terminal_code "cancelled" instead); it is readable via research.get_status, is resumable — call research.run with the same run_id — and never appears in a wait=true envelope.

stats.description: data_calls, total_calls, cost_usd, claims, duration_s, lint_issues
